events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A confirmed Atlas reservation was completed for Quarterly planning tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people with projector included, at a $280 CAD all-charges-included total, within the $350 limit.

Interpretação simulada: Gather provided a short path from prefilled meeting requirements to a confirmed Atlas reservation. The clearest helpful moments were the details-page confirmation that a projector was included and the itemized $280 all-in total on review, which let this persona verify every constraint before confirming.

Limites: This was a demo venue and the footer states reservations are saved only in this browser session and no payment was taken. The confirmation uses Tomorrow rather than a specific calendar date.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #5, #11, #13. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Confirmed reservation matches all meeting requirements
findings.observation: Confirmation screen #13 shows Atlas as Confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, with a reservation total of $280 CAD all charges included.
findings.expected: A visible confirmed reservation matching purpose, 12 attendees, projector, one-hour slot, and all-in total at or below $350.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and the saved charter success criteria.
findings.personaComment: This is exactly what I needed — confirmed, for 12 with a projector, and under budget.
findings.interpretation: The persona goal was fully accomplished efficiently with the first suitable room checked.
findings.uncertainty: The date is shown as Tomorrow rather than a calendar date, and the footer notes this is a demo venue with reservations saved only in this browser session.

findings.title: Itemized pre-confirmation total enabled a clear budget check
findings.observation: Review screen #11 itemized Room 1 hour $220, Projector $35, and Service charge $25, for a total of $280 CAD with all charges included, before the Confirm reservation action.
findings.expected: The complete cost should be visible before confirming so it can be checked against the $350 limit.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's $350 spending constraint and the details page promise in screenshot #9 that the booking total would be reviewed before confirming.
findings.personaComment: Seeing the full $280 total before confirming made it easy to stay within my allowance.
findings.interpretation: Transparent itemization reduced budget risk and avoided needing to compare other rooms unnecessarily.
findings.uncertainty: No taxes or other charges beyond the stated all-charges-included total were separately shown.

findings.title: Projector fit was not visible on the room card but was confirmed on details
findings.observation: Landing cards in screenshot #3 showed Atlas with 12 seats, Boardroom, and Fast Wi-Fi but no projector label; the Atlas details in screenshot #5 then explicitly stated Projector Included in your booking for 12 people.
findings.expected: Room options should make capacity and projector fit easy to verify.
findings.expectedSource: Inferred expectation from the persona's 12-person and projector requirements; the landing meeting bar already stated Projector required.
findings.personaComment: I was not sure about the projector from the card, but the next screen confirmed it clearly.
findings.interpretation: The initial card created brief uncertainty, but the next step resolved it without requiring a room change or extra search.
findings.uncertainty: Only Atlas and Willow cards were visible on the landing view; projector labelling for other rooms was not checked.

finding.interpretation: Gather provided a short path from prefilled meeting requirements to a confirmed Atlas reservation. The clearest helpful moments were the details-page confirmation that a projector was included and the itemized $280 all-in total on review, which let this persona verify every constraint before confirming.

persona.name: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.label: Alex · Executive assistant
persona.context: You are arranging the team’s quarterly planning meeting between other tasks. Any suitable room within the approved $350 total allowance is acceptable; you want to get the reservation completed efficiently.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $350. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose an appropriate available room and complete the booking efficiently without unnecessary comparisons.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: A clear, reliable path to a confirmed reservation and accurate final details.
persona.priorities: Meet the requirements and complete the reservation efficiently within the spending allowance.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Fresh synthetic persona retest; does not measure real-user impact.

experience.observation: Landing shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector required; Atlas is $220/hour with 12 seats and Willow is $235/hour with 12 seats, both available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: Atlas fits on seats and price at first glance, so I'll check it first to keep this quick.

feedback.summary: Room cards show 12 seats and $220-$235 hourly rates but do not list a projector, so fit is not fully confirmed on the card
feedback.why: I need seats for 12 plus a projector within $350 total; the hourly rate alone does not prove the all-in cost or projector is included.

experience.observation: Details page for Atlas shows Date Tomorrow, Time 10:00–11:00, People 12, Projector Included in your booking, with an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: Good — the projector is included, so this room fits. I'll add the meeting name.

feedback.summary: Atlas summary confirms projector is included for 12 people tomorrow 10:00–11:00, resolving the card's missing projector detail
feedback.why: That matches my non-negotiable projector and capacity needs before I spend time entering details.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and empty, with placeholder e.g. Quarterly planning.
experience.reaction: The name field is focused, so I'll enter the meeting purpose now.

experience.observation: Meeting name now shows Quarterly planning; Atlas summary still shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and a note that I will review the total before confirming.
experience.reaction: Name is in and I can check the total before confirming — I'll review it next.

feedback.summary: Page states I will review the booking total before confirming, so I can check the all-in cost against $350 before committing
feedback.why: Atlas was $220/hour, but fees could change the total; a pre-confirmation total check protects my spending limit.

experience.observation: Review shows Quarterly planning, projector and seating for 12, Atlas Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, with itemized total $280 CAD all charges included.
experience.reaction: Total is $280 all-in and everything matches, so I'll confirm this reservation.

feedback.summary: Itemized review shows $220 room + $35 projector + $25 service = $280 all charges included, clearly within my $350 limit
feedback.why: I can verify capacity, projector, meeting name, and the complete CAD total on one screen before confirming, so there is no budget surprise.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
